player_prompt.intro:
Talofa i Lights Out! E iai se gridi {size}x{size} o malama.
O lau faamoemoe o le faamalosia lea o MALAMA UMA (faaalia e '.')
A o e pulu se malama, e faafou ai ia lava ma ana tuaoi (luga/vaevaai/matau/to-clita).
Faia [row col] e pulu ai se malama (0-faavae, ona o le vaega saogalemu o 0-{max_index}).
E iai ni {max_turns} mafai e faaaogaina e faataunuu ai le puzzle.
Faasalalauga: 'O' = malama ON, '.' = malama OFF

invalid_move.wrong_format: E tatau ona i ai le faatulagaga [row col] lea o laina ma koluma e aofia ai numera atoa mai 0 i {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Faʻafetai lava! Ua e foia le paso i {moves_used} siitiaga!
